snippet.title: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1
snippet.description:
We are proud to announce the upcoming release of C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1 on Steam. Coming June 29th, 2026!

Wishlist it today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4796200/

Visit us on
The web: https://www.toomuchvoltage.com
Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/toomuchvoltage
Facebook: https://www.fb.com/toomuchvoltage

Following this release, we will be preparing to open source the underlying engine, HighOmega, on the following repo that currently has the SauRay(TM) feature branches: https://github.com/toomuchvoltage/HighOmega-public
